svg.title: Where the time goes
svg.desc: One panel per benchmark document, each on its own time axis. For each engine a bar cut into startup, preamble, body and writing the PDF (medians of the warm runs), with every run's wall time as a dot.
svg.text: Median of the warm runs, cut into phases. The dots are each run's wall time. Each panel has its own axis.
